_review: W_NEXT_NOT_LOADED: horde_horde_10-15 is the next band; it is written in a later phase.
W_NOT_IN_PACK: quest 840 (Conscript of the Horde) is not in the mulgore pack. It is the prerequisite of 842 and Tauren can take it at Razor Hill, so it was taken from data/raw.

W_XP_RANGE: 16090 of 22800 counted (71%). The pack holds fewer XP quests than the budget. Not counted by the validator: class chains (hunter 6065/6061/6087/6088/6089 about 3025 XP, warrior 1505/1502/1503 about 1135, shaman 2984 420) and kill XP, which is not modelled. A Tauren hunter lands near 84% with class XP; a warrior near 76%. Not taken: 870 The Forgotten Pools (680 XP) has no objective rows in the DB, only 'report back with your findings', so it cannot be placed honestly; 844 is exclusive with 854 and 861; Fizsprocket and the Clearcutter are lvl 12 elites, kept as optional-elite (revisit at 15). The 10-15 band should carry the remaining budget.

dropped.reason: Dwarven Digging: the Prospector's Picks have no DB source; only the forge object (Broken Tools) is known, so the 5-pick step cannot be placed honestly.
Gathering Leather: profession-gated (Skinning). Not leveling content; the band does not assume the skill.
Kodo Hide Bag: profession-gated (Leatherworking). Same rule as the other profession quests.
The Demon Scarred Cloak: no objective rows in the DB and the cloak's drop NPC has no spawn in this pack. The Ghost Howl lead cannot be placed.
Dropped in mulgore_01-05 too: the Dirt-stained Map starter has no spawn coordinates in the DB.
Plainstrider Menace is exclusive with the Tauren escort 854 and with 861. The route takes 854 and 861 for more XP on the same walk.
Earth Sapta re-get, dropped in mulgore_01-05 too; not part of the Call of Earth chain.
Call of Fire (Xanis, Thunder Bluff) is exclusive with 2984, which starts at Bloodhoof on this route.
